name: Experiment readout desk
why: Checks an A/B test plan before launch and reads the result with a confidence range when it ends.

name: Test result trust checker
why: Turns a finished test into a lift range, its money value and one ship call.

name: A/B test traffic checker
why: Quick check of whether traffic is enough for a test, and how many weeks it needs.

name: Holdout test planner
why: Plans a holdout to see whether a channel or email really adds sales, with a read-out table.

name: Incrementality test planner
why: Sizes a test of whether ad spend causes sales, with a cut, hold or scale rule.

name: Fraud rules setter
why: Simple fraud rules by risk level, the plain alternative to judge a fraud model against.

name: Prepare an AI pilot go decision
why: Checks AI pilot results against the baseline and a go or stop checklist.

name: Survey answer truth checker
why: Scores how far survey answers can be trusted before anyone acts on them.

name: Document a dataset analysis for reproduction
why: Writes down data, method and unsupported claims so another person can repeat the analysis.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Monthly churn check that shows whether last month's fix worked, a common score to validate.

name: Decision bias pile-up checker
why: Names the pressures bending a decision before a result is acted on.
